newsitem.title: USA: Peerless to be acquired for $1.67/shr.
newsitem.headline: Peerless to be acquired for $1.67/shr.

text.p: Peerless Industrial Group Inc said it agreed definitively to be acquired by R-B Capital Corp and R-B Acquisition Corp, both formed by Ridge Capital Corp and William Blair Mezzanine Capital Fund II LP, for $1.67 per share in cash, or a total of $11.3 million.
R-B Acquisition will commence a cash tender offer at $1.67 per share for all outstanding shares within five business days, the company said.
Following the tender, each share of Peerless stock not purchased in the tender will be converted into a right to receive $1.67 in cash.
